target.title: Add Claw status and remove lifecycle
target.body:
## Summary

Final OpenClaw PR in the current Claws stack. This adds the first supported lifecycle management commands over the state produced by the mutating apply PRs:

- `claws status [claw] --json` reports persisted Claw apply records, plugin artifact refs, and workspace file refs
- `claws remove <claw> --dry-run --json` previews removal without deleting files or refs
- `claws remove <claw> --yes --json` removes persisted Claw refs and deletes unchanged Claw-managed workspace files
- user-modified, oversized, missing, or already-deleted workspace files are retained or treated as stale cleanup instead of being deleted unsafely
- workspace removal preflights all refs before deleting any file, revalidates the managed hash immediately before unlinking, and keeps failed refs visible in status on partial cleanup errors
- artifact refs are removed as Claw provenance only; this does not uninstall plugin packages

## Stack

- RFC: openclaw/rfcs#27
- Validation/dry-run foundation: #101328
- Artifact provenance refs: #101755
- Workspace/persona files apply: #101973
- Plugin artifact installers + warning provenance: #102228
- This PR: Claw status/remove lifecycle

## Behavior Notes

This intentionally stops short of update, rollback, automation/crons, skill/MCP/connectors installers, and ClawHub discovery. It gives users an end-to-end supported lifecycle for the state that the current stack can already create: apply, inspect persisted state, preview removal, remove Claw-owned metadata, and clean unchanged managed workspace files.

`claws remove` does not ref-count-lock or uninstall plugins. It removes Claw refs so future plugin uninstall warnings no longer include the removed Claw.

## Real Behavior Proof

The E2E suite now runs a full real CLI lifecycle using `node --import tsx src/entry.ts`:

1. apply a local plugin Claw with `--yes --workspace --json`
2. verify `claws status <id> --json` reports artifact and workspace refs
3. verify `claws remove <id> --dry-run --json` previews workspace deletion without deleting the file
4. run `claws remove <id> --yes --json`
5. verify the managed workspace file is deleted
6. verify final `claws status <id> --json` is empty

## Validation

Run on WSL worktree `/root/src/openclaw-claws-pr6-lifecycle` at head `49eb30ad775269f7ad48e7817a1cc4c45acb70c6`:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle-state.test.ts src/state/openclaw-state-db.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/cli/plugins-cli.uninstall.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts src/cli/program/command-registry.test.ts src/cli/program/root-command-descriptions.test.ts
```

Result: passed 3 Vitest shards: unit 84 tests, CLI 42 tests, lifecycle E2E 5 tests.

```text
git diff --check
node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs
```

Result: passed.

```text
pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit --pretty false
```

Result: still blocked only by existing unrelated baseline:

```text
src/secrets/config-io.ts(12,17): error TS4058: Return type of exported function has or is using name 'configWritePostCommitRollback' from external module "/root/src/openclaw-claws-pr6-lifecycle/src/config/io" but cannot be named.
```

```text
codex review -c model=gpt-5.5 --base origin/user/giodl/claws-pr5-installers
```

Result: no actionable correctness issues found after fixes for review findings around stale workspace roots, partial delete preflight, hash revalidation, delete errors, and oversized modified files.
